audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2, Level 3, First item and 2+ items are marked Heimerdinger in the full layer but carry Akshan-favoured boilerplate — "both boomerang passes on him plus the passive proc is a third of his HP bar", "take over the lane and start roaming for revives".
audit.why: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 against Avengerang's 850, so Heimerdinger out-ranges Akshan outright once W is online — the level-2 stage in particular was claiming a poke war Akshan cannot win. The content layer already grades those stages his way.
audit.corrected: Each contradicted stage now names the mechanic that owns it: the 1325-range rockets at 2, the turret nest at 3, turret DPS beating Youmuu's at first item, and turret walls plus rocket waveclear at two.

audit.whatIsWrong: UPGRADE!!! never appears anywhere on the page — the level-6 spike discusses only Akshan's Comeuppance, as though Heimerdinger gets nothing at 6.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 and empowers his next spell. Against Akshan the one that matters is an upgraded CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, since the stun is what turns the nest from zoning into a kill. A level-6 section that only covers your own ultimate misreads the stage.
audit.corrected: UPGRADE!!! is now named in the mid text with its cooldown and the reason an upgraded grenade is the version to fear.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged that the page never names a single Heimerdinger ability — it says "E grenade", "W rockets", "turret nest" throughout. The full layer's tracked ability is the invented label "CH-2 Grenade (Stun)", and dosFull[2] called a whiffed grenade a "fifteen-second invitation". whys[1] and the early text also claim your Q out-ranges him.
audit.why: The real names are H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and UPGRADE!!!. The grenade is a flat 11s, not fifteen — a third shorter, which changes how often you can step up. And the range claim is backwards: Micro-Rockets are 1325 to Avengerang's 850, so he out-ranges you the moment W is up. Telling a player they win the poke war here gets them killed at max range.
audit.corrected: Real ability names used throughout both layers, the grenade's flat 11s replaces the fifteen-second figure everywhere, and the range claim is corrected to say the rockets out-reach you by 475 units so you never poke-war him flat.

edits.before: Heimer's whole early game is the turret nest, but it takes a few seconds and multiple casts to stack — before it's online your Q (Avengerang) out-ranges him and your auto-attack plus passive follow-up shot out-trades him. Punish him at Levels 2-3 when only one or two turrets are down: Q-poke, walk up for an auto-and-passive trade, then back off before the turrets and a W rocket stack damage on you. The thing to dodge is his E grenade — eat it and you're stunned, then the turrets and rockets melt you. Don't facecheck brush for a W roam while his E is up.
edits.after: Heimer's whole early game is the H-28 G Evolution Turret nest, but it takes a few seconds and multiple casts to stack — before it's online your Q (Avengerang) beats his half-built nest and your auto plus passive follow-up shot out-trades him. Punish at Levels 2-3 when only one or two turrets are down: Q-poke, walk up for an auto-and-passive trade, then back off before the turrets and Hextech Micro-Rockets stack damage on you. Never poke-war him flat — those rockets reach 1325 to your 850. The thing to dodge is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, a flat 11s stun; eat it and the nest melts you.

edits.before: Once his nest is fully built he zones you off the wave, so this becomes a respect game — you can't just walk into three turrets and a rocket to trade. Your E (Heroic Swing) is both your engage and your escape: bait or sidestep his E grenade, swing in for a Q and auto trade, then jump off the swing and out before the turrets and his stun catch you. At 6 your R (Comeuppance) finishes a Heimer you've already poked low because it scales up to 200% with his missing HP — but it has no dash and is interrupted, so fire it from range or right off an E swing, never as a blind engage into the nest.
edits.after: Once his nest is fully built he zones you off the wave, so this becomes a respect game — you can't walk into three turrets and Hextech Micro-Rockets to trade. Your E (Heroic Swing) is both engage and escape: bait or sidestep CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, swing in for a Q and auto trade, then jump off before the turrets and that flat 11s stun catch you. At 6 he gets UPGRADE!!! (100/85/70) to empower his next spell — an upgraded grenade is the one to fear. Your R (Comeuppance) finishes a Heimer you've poked low, but it has no dash, so fire it from range or right off an E swing, never as a blind engage.

notes: Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or STRUCTURE hit. If Heimerdinger's deployed turrets count as structures, a turret sitting between you and him would eat your entire ultimate — which would be the single most important fact on this page. Riot's data does not classify turret units, so I did not assert it. This is worth confirming in game before someone relies on R through a nest. Also, spikes[1] and whys[5] both claim Comeuppance scales 'up to 200%' with missing HP; no ratio appears in Riot's description, so those were left as-is and logged unverified.
